consequence.statement: The split_queries_by_interval setting configured in the query_range YAML section will be ignored; it must be moved to limits_config to take effect.
consequence.remediation: Migrate split_queries_by_interval from query_range section to limits_config section in your Loki configuration.

assertion.statement: The configuration key split_queries_by_interval is removed from the query_range YAML section in Loki 3.0.0 and must be configured in Limits Config instead.
